name: Navigation Flow Testing
description: Walk important routes in the shared Browser session, including back and forward, and report dead links or unexpected redirects from the resulting URL.

permissionsRequired.reason: Open the start of the flow.
Follow a route in the same session.
Capture a wrong or dead destination.
Record the URL after each hop.

validation.rule: Each checked route cites the URL browser_navigate or browser_evidence returned. Dead links and unexpected redirects are reported only from those results.
